added_failure_basis: The reviewed manifest carries no baseline_suite or after_suite entry: its write paths hold no test file and its suite fence is unarmed, so no suite pair exists to difference. Its only machine-checked gate is the comparison driver recorded in gate-repair.log (job 1339005, revision 4b9f1c315cf723ad0141cf334f039ee87fa034e8), which reports '7 entries passed, 0 failed, 3 negative controls fired' with EXIT=0. Added failures against that base: none.

findings.severity: non-blocking: the plot-columns entry's implementation_a string names 'PolyPlot and PolyPlotChildren', but implementations_found in the committed receipt lists only nova.frame.polyplot.PolyPlot.update_columns, so the receipt asserts an implementation was compared that the discovery step did not find.
findings.text: plot-columns implementation_a label claims PolyPlotChildren was compared; the receipt's implementations_found shows only PolyPlot.update_columns.

findings.severity: non-blocking: the seventh entry's four candidate pairs carry a keeper and removable lines inside receipt.json but no decision record under hot-path-duplicates/ and no statement of which route executes which, while plan §5 done_when asks each entry be raised to S28's coordinator as one decision naming the entry; those four decisions will not reach the coordinator.
findings.text: the four flagged candidate pairs are measured but have no per-entry decision record, so no S28 decision names them.

findings.severity: non-blocking: the receipt carries no revision field, so the revision the register cites for it (4b9f1c315) is provable only from the header of gate-repair.log rather than from the committed artifact.
findings.text: receipt.json lacks a revision stamp; its provenance rests on the gate log, not the artifact.

findings.severity: non-blocking: eight of the eleven delivered paths (job.sh, receipt.json, and six decision records) lie outside the five declared write paths even after the first repair round; the register documents the gap and every path is inside the section's evidence/prototype area, but the declared scope does not cover what landed.
findings.text: delivery exceeds the declared write paths by eight files, documented but not covered by the declaration.

rubric.durability: answered: no test fails if the register or driver regresses; the driver's enforced negative controls guard the comparison but are not wired into the suite.
rubric.evidence: answered: the driver gate and three negative controls are recorded in gate-repair.log at revision 4b9f1c315 and reconcile with receipt.json.
rubric.fit: answered: descriptive file and symbol names, no plan or stage labels in source; one label mismatch in a receipt string.
rubric.goal_fidelity: answered: the register at hot-path-duplicates.html delivers the record plan §5 asks for, with six compared entries plus four measured candidates.
rubric.reuse: answered: the driver reuses scripts/iron_operator_bound/reuse_check.py definitions() and cross-checks it, authoring only the body-digest and near-identity grouping that no nova owner provides.
rubric.scope_discipline: answered: eight of eleven delivered paths fall outside the declared set; all lie inside the section's evidence/prototype area and are enumerated in the register.
